title: Debt Issuance in the Era of Passive Investment
eligible_reason: Single common shock, not staggered. post17 = 1 for offerings on or after 24 Jan 2017 (one date for all issues; codes/6 line 137), interacted with bond (IG bonds vs IG syndicated loans) or igtest (IG vs HY bonds). Unit of observation is the issue (bond/loan offering), not a panel of units; the only FE is two-digit SIC industry (absorb(sic2)), no calendar-time FE, and every column adds macro and firm-level time-varying controls ($lr_m). Table 4 uses zero-inflated ordered probit predicted bins; Table 5 regresses issue size on continuous passive-demand shares. No main-text specification is a staggered binary DiD with unit and time FE.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe. Table 2: bunching at index-inclusion size thresholds, reghdfe bin250/bin300/dummy299 post17##bond $lr_m, absorb(sic2) cluster(firm_id month) (codes/7 lines 104-123). Table 3: reghdfe B post17##bond / issuer post17##bond covid##bond, absorb(sic2). Placebo (lines 302-341) redefines post17 at 1 Jan 2012. Bond-index rule change (Bloomberg Barclays minimum size $300m) is a single date.

screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text, no abstract in candidates/frame). Title and authors from README. Single-date index-rule change with industry FE and time-varying controls; licensed data not shipped.
